function.name: LOAD_IMAGE
function.abstract: It recovers an image of disk detecting automatically his type, using SDL_image.DLL

description.p: This function recovers of disk an image detecting automatically his format, and creates a graph in memory that can be used in the habitual operations. The function returns an entire identifier that represents the loaded graph, that is imported like pertaining to the library 0. For example, PUT_SCREEN (0, LOAD_IMAGE("x.jpg")) will put like background of screen the loaded image from archive x.jpg. If you want to have more memory then unload the graph recovered with this function, that can be made using the function .

The function supports actually the following formats:
JPEG
PNG
PCX
GIF
BMP
TIFF
LBM
XPM
XCF
PNM

The images of 8 bits will be imported like images of 8 bits, although the palette of colours of the image will be recovered only in the case of this is the first image in being loaded in the program.
The rest of formats of colour will be converted internally to 16 bits.
This function does not support GIF animations.

The transparencies in the image will be imported for graphs of 16 or 32 bits with alpha channel (like PNG format) so the pixels with a transparency of 128 or more will be imported like transparent in the final graph.

note.p: Actually, it exists a compatibility problem with the functions of load of PNG. It is recommended to use the incorporated function in the standard graph library LOAD_PNG to recover these images.
